recipe.criteria: 45-degree incline bench press with shoulder-width grip (span 4 model units, reduced from 6.6). Stable feet, head and back support, controlled press from upper chest and return; 3.5 seconds up, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds down.

Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
